title: concert poster , logo designing
desc:
The task is to turn our upcoming music concert into something people can’t scroll past. I need a striking advertising poster, polished photos, and a short, high-energy promo video that all work together under one visual theme.  

Here’s the scope I have in mind:  
• Poster – A3 print-ready and web versions, bold typography, clear date/venue, and space for sponsor logos.  
• Photo edits – Retouch and colour-grade the artist shots so they drop straight into the poster and our socials.  
• Promo video – 30-60 seconds, cut from the raw clips I’ll supply, synced to the headline track, ending on the event details.  

Everything should carry the same look and feel so our audience recognises the concert instantly, whether they see it on a street wall, Instagram story, or YouTube ad. I’ll share brand colours, fonts, and footage as soon as we start.  

Delivery deadline: any time within the next month, but the sooner the better so we can start the ad run. Source files (PSD/AI, Lightroom presets, Premiere/After Effects project) should be included with the finals.  

If this sounds like your kind of creative sprint, let’s make some noise.

title: Wedding Entrance & Tribute Videography
desc:
The reception will take place in an indoor hall and I want guests to enjoy a real-time view of our grand entrance on the big screen. I’ll rely on you to capture the moment, stream it live to the supplied projector or large TV, and make sure the feed is smooth, well-lit and clearly audible from the first step through the doors to our arrival at the head table.

Ahead of the day, I also need a short pre-dance tribute video that we can play just before our first dance. Think of it as a heartfelt montage set to romantic music—photos, short clips, and any candid footage we provide—edited into a polished piece that flows naturally with the chosen soundtrack and finishes at the perfect cue for us to take the floor.

Deliverables  
• Live multi-camera (or single-camera if you’re confident) coverage of the entrance, streamed to the in-hall screen/projector in HD or better, with backup recording for later use.  
• Final edited “pre-dance tribute” video, 3–5 minutes long, colour-graded, mixed with the romantic track, delivered in MP4 (1080p) and a web-ready version.  
• All raw footage transferred to us on a drive or secure download link within a week of the event.

Acceptance Criteria  
• Zero noticeable lag or dropouts on the live stream.  
• Tribute video approved after one round of minor tweaks.  
• Audio levels balanced for both live stream and edited video.

If you already work with switchers such as ATEM Mini, stable streaming encoders, and full-frame or 4K cameras that downscale

title: Precise PDF-to-Docs Transcription
desc:
I have a short PDF of roughly 540 words that must be reproduced in Google Docs exactly as it appears now. Every word, line break, and piece of basic formatting (bold, italics, paragraph spacing) needs to carry over so the final document mirrors the source—no additions, omissions, or typos.

What I will share:
• The original PDF file.  
• A blank Google Docs link with edit permission.

What I need back:
• The Google Docs file populated with the text, accurately transferred.  
• A quick note confirming you have double-checked the word count and formatting.

Because the content is text-only, no image handling is involved. A keen eye for detail and a clean copy-and-paste workflow using a PDF reader and Google Docs will keep this simple yet precise. If you can finish promptly without sacrificing accuracy, that’s all I ask.

title: Customize Nano/Micro MDM Deployment Policies
desc:
I run a Linux-based instance of both nanoMDM and microMDM and I need a developer who can dive into their configuration layer to fine-tune software-deployment policies. My main goal is to enforce granular permissions management—who can install what, when, and under which conditions—across enrolled Apple devices without disrupting the existing enrollment workflow.

You will be working directly on the Linux host, updating configuration files and, when necessary, adjusting the Go code behind nanoMDM/microMDM to expose the policy controls I need. Expect to handle token-based authentication, profile signing, and the overall packaging pipeline so that newly approved apps propagate automatically while anything outside the policy is silently blocked.

Deliverables
• Updated nanoMDM/microMDM configs (or patched source) reflecting the new permissions rules  
• A short, repeatable script or Ansible role to apply the changes on fresh servers  
• Verification report showing successful deployment and denial scenarios on at least two test devices

Acceptance Criteria
The final setup must push approved software with no manual touches, log any blocked attempts, and survive a full system reboot on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.

If you have recent experience bending nanoMDM or microMDM to your will—and you’re comfortable debugging on Linux—let’s get started.

title: Faceless Educational YouTube Editing
desc:
I’m producing a series of faceless YouTube videos and need an editor who can turn my script, stock footage, and B-roll into an engaging educational piece. The finished video should flow smoothly, use text overlays to highlight key points, and feature background music that supports the learning mood without distracting viewers.  


Hi, I’m looking for a video editor experienced in creating faceless YouTube videos about natural disasters, especially tornadoes.

I’m specifically looking for someone who knows how to effectively use survivor footage/interviews, archival news footage, storm-chasing footage, real disaster footage, maps, weather graphics, photos, sound effects, and cinematic documentary-style editing.

If you have edited similar tornado or natural-disaster videos before, please send me your portfolio and relevant examples.

I’ll supply:  
• A detailed script with on-screen cue notes  
• Curated footage and images (royalty-free)  
• Branding guidelines for fonts and colours  

You’ll handle:  
• Assembling the visuals to match the narrative timing  
• Designing clear, on-brand text overlays for titles, facts, and calls to action  
• Selecting or mixing background music that fits an educational tone and is copyright-safe  
• Basic colour correction, light motion graphics, and sound balancing so everything feels polished  

No voice-over is required for this edit; the visuals and text carry the lesson. The final deliverable is a 1080p MP4 plus the editable project file

title: SEO partner to take full ownership of my site’s visibility
desc:
I need a seasoned SEO partner to take full ownership of my site’s visibility and drive it to higher positions on Google. The goal is clear: improve organic rankings across the board, and I’m looking for complete support—on-page, off-page, and technical.

Scope of work  
• On-page SEO: fresh keyword research, refined metadata, content optimisation, internal-link sculpting, and schema implementation that aligns with Google’s best practices.  
• Off-page SEO: authority link building through white-hat outreach, digital PR, and backlink profile cleanup.  
• Technical SEO: full audit, page-speed fixes, Core Web Vitals tuning, mobile and crawl-ability improvements, and structured data validation via Google Search Console.

Acceptance criteria  
1. A baseline and follow-up ranking report that proves measurable gains for agreed-upon target keywords.  
2. A technical audit document listing issues, actions taken, and post-fix validation.  
3. Monthly performance summary from Google Analytics and Search Console showing organic growth.

You will have access to the CMS, Analytics, and Search Console. Please outline your proposed workflow, tools you rely on (e.g., Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush), and realistic timelines for the first visible ranking lift.

title: Need USA Accounting Leads
desc:
I am putting together a fresh prospect list of senior-level and accounting-focused contacts across the United States and need someone who can source accurate, ready-to-use data for me. The people I care about most include C-suite decision makers (CFO, CEO, President) as well as heads of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and general accounting functions.  

The data must be recent and verifiable. A LinkedIn profile URL or a ZoomInfo record for every contact is mandatory so I can confirm each person’s role before outreach.

Deliverables  
• Spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets) containing, for each contact:  
  – Full name  
  – Job title & department  
  – Company name & website  
  – Corporate email (no generic info@ addresses)  
  – Direct phone number if available  
  – Location (city, state)  
  – LinkedIn profile or ZoomInfo link  

Acceptance criteria  
• Minimum 95 % email validity when checked through ZeroBounce or a similar tool  
• All companies must be U.S.-based and currently active  
• No duplicates; every record unique by email + company  

If you already have an existing database that meets these requirements, tell me how many records you can supply and the timeframe for delivery. Otherwise, outline the tools and methods you will use (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, etc.) and an estimated turnaround.  

I look forward to reviewing your approach and starting quickly once we confirm the scope.

title: Guest Speaker Release Contract
desc:
I already drafted a release agreement with AI for six guest speakers who appear in my forthcoming book and companion online course. Now I need a lawyer-grade version that a publishing house can rely on without hesitation..... using what I have developed as a starting point to minimise work of freelancer and ensuring all main points are covered

Scope  
• One clear, comprehensive contract that secures worldwide, perpetual permission to use each guest’s video, audio and transcript excerpts in every format (print, e-book, audiobook, streaming course, translations, etc.).  
• Language that makes it obvious the material may sit behind a paid course wall—the fee only covers production, hosting and day-to-day platform costs, not profit.  
• Explicit confirmation that we may edit or condense the interviews for the book while keeping the full recordings in the course.  
• Clauses on intellectual-property ownership, moral rights waivers, publicity rights, indemnification and governing law, drafted to conventional publishing standards.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Final document delivered in editable Word format.  
2. Read-through version with plain-English comments explaining each clause.  
3. Ready for signature with space for six individual names or a template merge field.  

If you have publishing-sector contract experience and can turn this around quickly, I’d love to put the finishing touches on this project with you.

title: Phát Triển Game Mu Online
desc:
Tôi muốn xây dựng một phiên bản Mu Online chạy mượt trên Windows, Mac và Mobile (iOS/Android). Dự án cần hoàn thiện cả client lẫn server, bảo đảm đồng bộ dữ liệu nhân vật và vật phẩm giữa các nền tảng.

Giao diện sẽ được thiết kế lại hoàn toàn để tự căn chỉnh theo từng thiết bị, giữ đúng tinh thần Mu Online nhưng tối ưu cho màn hình desktop lẫn cảm ứng.

Các tính năng trọng tâm tôi cần có ngay trong bản đầu tiên:
• Chế độ chơi nhiều người với cơ chế party, guild và PK thời gian thực.  
• Hệ thống vật phẩm và trang bị phong phú, rớt ngẫu nhiên, có cấp độ nâng cấp.  
• Các nhân vật có thể tùy chỉnh ngoại hình, kỹ năng và cây thuộc tính.

Yêu cầu kỹ thuật:
– Codebase thống nhất (Unity, Unreal hoặc engine cross-platform tương đương) để dễ bảo trì.  
– Server backend ổn định, phân cụm được, có API rõ ràng cho ứng dụng mobile.  
– Cơ sở dữ liệu bảo mật, hỗ trợ mở rộng số lượng người chơi.  
– Tài liệu build, hướng dẫn triển khai và bộ source đầy đủ.

Ưu tiên bạn đã từng làm MMORPG hoặc game đa nền tảng. Hãy cho tôi biết công nghệ bạn định dùng, mốc thời gian ước tính và ví dụ sản phẩm tương tự bạn từng hoàn thành.

title: PhD Co Author plus reviewer for Deep Learning Paper
desc:
My current manuscript applies neural-network models to protein research, and I want to elevate it to a publishable, high-impact journal submission. The technical groundwork is in place—data collected, models built in PyTorch—but I need a seasoned, PhD-level mind to refine the methodology, strengthen the theoretical framing, and share full co-authorship on all resulting publications.  

You would collaborate with me on each stage of the writing cycle: sharpening the literature review, validating the experimental design, running supplementary analyses, and polishing the final text to meet journal standards in computational biology and AI. Because I’m planning a series of follow-up studies, I’m looking for a long-term scholarly partnership; your willingness to act as a professional reference for future academic or industry applications is an essential part of this relationship.  

Key deliverables  
• Revised and annotated model code with reproducible results  
• Co-written manuscript ready for peer review (LaTeX or Word format)  
• Response letters for reviewer comments, if needed  
• Formal reference letter once our collaboration is established  

Familiarity with protein sequence datasets, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and standard statistical packages will let us move quickly. I’m flexible on meeting schedules and authorship order as long as responsibilities are shared equitably and deadlines are met. If contributing cutting-edge neural network research and building an ongoin

title: .NET E-Commerce Backend Optimization
desc:
Our live e-commerce site is built on the Microsoft .NET stack and, while feature-complete, the backend has begun to drag under load. Pages that once rendered in under a second now spike past five, occasional time-outs appear in the logs, and CPU usage sits uncomfortably high. I’m looking for help focused strictly on bug fixes and ongoing maintenance, with the immediate priority being performance bottlenecks on the server side.

You’ll start by profiling the application (IIS, ASP.NET MVC / Web API, Entity Framework, SQL Server) to pinpoint slow spots—inefficient queries, memory leaks, or blocking calls. From there, I need clean, well-commented patches that restore sub-second response times under typical traffic and remain stable in our staging environment for at least 48 hours before deployment.

Deliverables  
• Diagnostic report outlining root causes and performance metrics before/after fixes  
• Refactored .NET code and updated database scripts where required  
• A concise hand-off note describing changes, new settings (caching, connection pooling, etc.), and any monitoring recommendations

Acceptance criteria  
• Average backend response ≤ 1 s on 95% of requests under current load  
• No new exceptions introduced in Application Insights for 72 hours post-deploy  
• All existing unit tests pass; any new tests you add included in solution

If you have solid experience squeezing every millisecond out of .NET e-commerce apps, let’s talk.

title: Cerrador de Ventas B2B para Servicios TI
desc:
Buscamos un vendedor/closer freelance para cerrar clientes de un servicio de gestión de TI mensual dirigido a pymes en Perú (seguridad web, backups, mantenimiento y soporte técnico).

El trabajo consiste en contactar un lote de prospectos ya identificados —cada uno con un hallazgo técnico concreto que sirve de gancho de conversación (por ejemplo: certificado de seguridad por vencer, sitio sin protecciones configuradas, software sin soporte)—, agendar reuniones breves con quienes muestren interés, manejar objeciones básicas y cerrar el acuerdo o coordinarlo con nuestro equipo comercial.

Modelo de trabajo: inicia en modalidad freelance por comisión; existe posibilidad real de transición a un esquema con pago base según resultados del primer mes, a conversar directamente con los postulantes preseleccionados.

Buscamos a alguien con experiencia en ventas B2B o consultivas, idealmente en tecnología o servicios digitales, buena comunicación escrita en español, y disponibilidad para seguimiento constante y ordenado de cada contacto.

title: Rental Boyfriend Booking Website
desc:
I’m building a straightforward “rental boyfriend” web service and need a developer who can deliver a clean, mobile-friendly site focused on two core modules:

1. User profiles  
   Visitors must be able to browse and search simple profiles that show a photo, name, short bio, and age. No complex preference matching is required at this stage—just the essentials presented attractively. An admin area should let me create, edit, hide, or delete these profiles quickly.

2. Booking with payment integration  
   Each profile needs a “Book Now” flow that collects the date, start time, duration, and contact info, then routes the user directly to a secure payment gateway (Stripe or PayPal—open to your recommendation). After payment, the system should email a booking confirmation to the client and notify the profile owner. For now we can skip real-time availability checks and cancellation handling; keeping the flow fast and simple is the priority.

Admin convenience  
Besides profile management, I’ll need a dashboard to see all bookings at a glance, update their status (paid, pending, completed), and export basic reports. Clear code and concise documentation are important so I can maintain the site after launch.

Tech stack  
I’m flexible—WordPress with WooCommerce bookings, a Laravel/React pair, or another modern stack you prefer. What matters is reliability, PCI-compliant payment handling, and responsive design that looks great on phones.

Deliverables  
• Fully functional website depl

title: Bulk Abstract AI Clip Production
desc:
I’m building a library of visually striking, AI-generated entertainment clips and need a partner who can turn out work in volume—hundreds now and eventually thousands. Every video should feel hypnotic and experimental, firmly within an abstract aesthetic rather than realistic or cartoonish, and short enough to keep viewers watching in a quick-scroll environment.

Use whatever pipeline suits you best—Runway Gen-2, Deforum/Stable Diffusion, Pika, After Effects automation, or a custom model—provided the output is copyright-safe and delivered as standard MP4. Consistency of quality is crucial, but I also want enough variation in color, texture, and motion to keep the catalogue fresh.

I’ll commission the work in batches so we can confirm style and workflow before scaling up. For each clip, send:
- The rendered file in 1080p (or higher) H.264/MP4
- The prompts, seeds, or project settings so I can reproduce or tweak future variations

Speed is important, but creativity comes first. Please share a sample or link to previous abstract AI clips so I can see how your style aligns with the project vision.

title: Retro 60th Birthday Cartoon
desc:
For my sister’s milestone 60th, I’m commissioning a single, high-resolution cartoon scene that captures her, her daughter, the nieces and nephews, and their lovable Labrador all piling into a classic VW Beetle. The piece needs to feel unmistakably 1960s—think flower-power colors, balloons, groovy patterns, vintage outfits and a decorative, era-themed backdrop—while staying light-hearted and whimsical throughout.

Likeness is the priority, so I’ll supply a set of clear reference photos for every family member and the dog. From there, the fun is yours: exaggerate just enough to keep it playful, but hold on to recognizable faces and personalities. I’m picturing a warm, nostalgic atmosphere that will work equally well as a large poster, an invitation, or a keepsake print.

Deliverables
• Final artwork in print-ready CMYK, minimum 4500 px on the longest side (PNG or JPG).  
• One layered source file (PSD, AI, or Procreate).  
• Up to two revision rounds to fine-tune likeness and color palette.

Please attach portfolio links that showcase cartoon family illustrations, pet caricatures, vehicles, or any retro/hippie projects so I can quickly gauge stylistic fit. I’m excited to see how you’ll bring this joyful birthday memory to life.

title: 40-Page Serious Cartoon Comic
desc:
The project centres on a full-length, 40-page comic book drawn in a clean, expressive Cartoon style yet driven by a Serious narrative that speaks to a teenage readership. All story beats, panel pacing and visual humour must serve the deeper dramatic arc, so the artwork should balance lively, stylised figures with believable emotion.

I have an outline and key character notes; the rest—from thumbnails through final colour—needs to be developed. Consistency of line weight, palette and lettering is essential so the finished book feels cohesive when printed or viewed digitally.

Deliverables expected:  
• Complete storyboard/thumbnails for approval  
• Fully inked and coloured sequential art for 40 interior pages  
• Front and back cover designs that match the interior style  
• Layered source files (PSD/AI/CLIP) plus a 300 dpi CMYK print-ready PDF

Acceptance criteria: every page must be print-ready, dialogue correctly lettered, and all files supplied in the agreed formats. A brief check-in at roughs, halfway inks and final colour will keep us aligned on schedule and tone.

title: Modern Bold Bedroom Makeover
desc:
I'm seeking expert guidance to decorate my modern-style bedroom with a bold color scheme. I'm particularly focused on wall decorations and lighting.

Key Requirements:
- Modern decor expertise
- Bold color scheme integration
- Creative wall decoration solutions
- Innovative lighting design

Ideal Skills:
- Interior design experience
- Strong color coordination
- Proficiency in modern decor trends

I'm looking for a professional who can provide tips, ideas, and possibly a design plan to bring my vision to life.

title: Reliable English-Somali Document Translation
desc: ​I need an experienced translator to translate documents accurately from English into Somali. The documents are in Word and PDF formats, and maintaining the original formatting is important.

title: Clothing Brand & Store Identity
desc:
I’m preparing to launch a clothing and accessories retail store and want every touch-point—online and in-store—to feel seamless and unmistakably “us.” I need a partner who can map out our entire brand journey and then bring it to life, from the logo on the swing tag to the atmosphere shoppers feel the moment they step through the door.  

Here’s what the collaboration will cover:  
• Logo design: a primary logo plus any supporting marks, delivered in vector and web formats.  
• Brand strategy: positioning, tone of voice, colour & typography palette, and clear usage guidelines compiled into a brand book.  
• Marketing materials: launch campaign concepts, social templates, store signage and print collateral ready for production.  
• Store design: a cohesive interior concept—including layout, fixtures, lighting and merchandising guidelines—that translates the brand strategy into a physical experience.  

I’m looking for someone who can guide the process end-to-end, present mood boards and 3D mock-ups, refine based on feedback, and coordinate final artwork files for printers, fabricators or web developers as needed. Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma or Sketch for branding, and SketchUp, AutoCAD or similar for spatial planning will be important.  

If you have a track record of building fashion retail identities and can show examples of both branding and store environments you’ve delivered, let’s talk about timelines and the milestones that will get us to op

title: Passionate Female Chess Enthusiast for Videos
desc:
Female Chess Video Presenter / Model Needed
We are looking for a charismatic, charming and camera-confident female model/presenter to create short videos relating to chess.

The videos will be approximately 2 minutes each and will be designed to make chess content entertaining, engaging and approachable. You don't necessarily need to be a professional chess player—we are primarily looking for someone with a natural on-camera presence, expressive personality and ability to connect with an audience.

What you'll do
Record short, approximately 2-minute videos based around chess.
Present provided scripts or talking points in a natural, conversational way.
Bring personality, enthusiasm and charm to the videos.
Make the content feel fun and engaging rather than overly formal.
Be comfortable speaking directly to the camera.
Potentially demonstrate simple chess positions or interact with a chessboard/online chess interface.
Record multiple takes when necessary to achieve the best delivery.
Ideal Candidate
Female, confident and comfortable appearing on camera.
Attractive, friendly and charismatic screen presence.
Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation.
Naturally expressive and engaging.
Able to follow a script while making the delivery sound spontaneous.
Interest in chess is a plus, but extensive chess knowledge is not required.
Previous experience with TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, UGC, presenting, acting or promotional videos is highly desirable.
Video Requirements
Approxima
